test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The National Leaders of India were __imbued__ with qualities like leadership, nationalities and bravery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Filled**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**imbued**" means to fill or saturate with a particular quality or feeling. (किसी विशेष गुण या भावना से भरना या संतृप्त करना)

 
 
• **For example**: *The painting was imbued with vibrant colours.*
 
 
 
• Marked option "**Filled**" describes how something or someone is saturated with a particular attribute, emotion, or characteristic. (कोई चीज़ या कोई व्यक्ति किसी विशेष गुण, भावना या विशेषता से कैसे संतृप्त है)
 
 
• **For example**: *The artist filled the canvas with vibrant colours, creating a stunning masterpiece.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that "Filled" is a synonym of "imbued".
 
• The sentence is saying that the National Leaders of India possessed qualities such as leadership, nationalities, and bravery.

Hence, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Habituated**" means to be accustomed or familiar with something. (किसी चीज़ से अभ्यस्त या परिचित होना)
 
• "**Tinged**" means to colour or affect slightly. (थोड़ा सा रंग देना या प्रभावित करना)
 
• "**Sprinkled**" means to scatter or distribute something in small amounts. (किसी चीज़ को थोड़ी मात्रा में बिखेरना या वितरित करना)
